notes.title: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2 ANNOUNCED
notes.notes:
"After five years in hiding, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself."

[olist]
[*] A new point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age classics such as [b]Broken Sword[/b] and [b]Gabriel Knight[/b]
[*] Compelling blend of comedy, supernatural mystery, and conspiracy-steeped intrigue
[*] Alternate control between Lars and his returning cohort Alice
[*] [b]Challenging but logical puzzles[/b] seamlessly integrated into the story
[*] Explore more than 50 stylish hand-drawn HD locations across [b]Rome, Palestine, India and Japan[/b]
[*] Original atmospheric soundtrack and full English voice-overs (with German and Italian subtitles)
[*] Sequel to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" ([b]95% positive reviews[/b] on Steam), though no prior familiarity is necessary
[/olist]

notes.title: The Hand of Glory - The Blowtorch Files is out NOW!
notes.notes:
[i]"A young girl, Erica Thimber, vanishes into thin air overnight. Is it a classic teen runaway? That's not what Lazarus Bundy, renowned serial killer hunter in charge of the case, perceives.

It is up to you, senior analyst, to help Bundy with his investigation, providing technical support and assistance.

Will you shed some light on the mystery?
Or will you end up burned by it?"[/i]

♦ [b]Prequel[/b] to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" ([b]97% positive reviews[/b] on Steam)

♦ Same setting, different formula: instead of a traditional point & click adventure, in "The Blowtorch Files" you will face an [b]innovative textual adventure[/b]

♦ Not only texts, also [b]puzzles[/b]: use your sight, your hearing and do researches on your browser in order to solve the case!

♦ Help [b]Lazarus Bundy[/b] to stop the individual who's been terrorizing Miami

♦ Completely [b]FREE![/b]
